summary: TransMontagne Partners LLC (the Registrant) filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing its immediate election to cease voluntary SEC periodic reporting, effective May 15, 2026. No tender offer or going-private premium; the company as a voluntary filer incurs no Section 13/15(d) obligations and will not file Form 15. It will instead provide financial information on a private bondholder site. The move is driven by cost savings, with no shareholder vote or regulator approval required. Watch for bondholder access processes and any subsequent M&A triggered by reduced public disclosure; no arbitrage angle. The US-equivalent filing maps cleanly as a voluntary delisting of reporting status.
